enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow under head. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn onto back. Place arms at sides. Remain still. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket down to waist. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Straighten legs. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, showering
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Wash face. Turn off light.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into pan. Turn on stove. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Rinse plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, packing bag, checking schedule on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt and pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Pick up bag. Place laptop inside. Close bag. Pick up phone. Check schedule on phone. Put phone in pocket.

Walk out of bedroom. Pick up bag. Walk to front door. Open door. Step outside. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit office on community program coordination
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check meetings. Make phone calls. Talk to colleagues. Write reports. Attend meeting. Take notes. Print documents. Review documents. File documents. Type on computer.

Stand up from desk. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Close refrigerator. Walk to table. Sit down. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Take out apple. Take out water bottle. Open water bottle. Drink water. Eat sandwich. Eat apple. Wipe mouth with napkin. Close water bottle. Place trash in bin. Stand up. Walk back to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit office on community program coordination
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Check emails. Reply to emails. Make phone calls. Meet with team. Discuss program logistics. Update spreadsheets. Create presentation. Send emails. Attend conference call. Take notes. Print documents. Review budget. Organize files.

Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to home. Open door. Enter home. Close door. Lock door.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Eat dinner. Drink water. Rinse plate.

Walk into living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer, browsing phone, leisure activities
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Enter password. Open browser. Browse websites. Check social media. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Browse phone. Put down phone. Open game on laptop. Play game. Pick up phone. Reply to message. Continue playing game. Close game. Watch video. Close laptop.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk into bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Turn to right side. Place hands under pillow. Stretch legs. Remain still. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Continue sleeping.
